newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Gulf rigs under contract down 1 at 159.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Gulf rigs under contract down 1 at 159.

text.p: There were 159 rigs under contract in the U.S. Gulf as of Jan. 3, down one from the period ending Dec. 27, Offshore Data Services said Friday.
The utilization rate for rigs working in the Gulf, based on a total fleet of 180, was 88.3 percent.
The number of working rigs in the European/Mediterranean area remained the same this week at 106 rigs under contract out of a total fleet of 106, a utilization rate of 100 percent.
The worldwide rig count fell one to 556 out of a total fleet of 605, making the utilization rate 91.9 percent.
A total of 363 rigs were exploring for crude oil, up 10 from last week. The number of rigs searching for gas was down 16 at 480, while the number of miscellaneous drilling projects remained at two.
There were 184 rigs drilling directionally, 64 drilling horizontally and 597 drilling vertically.
In Canada, the number of working rigs surged by 154 in the week to 358 vs. 300 a year ago.
The weekly rig count reflects the number of rigs exploring for oil and gas, not those producing oil and gas.
